shortcuts.record-help: Release the keys to save. Tab moves between actions; Esc cancels.
shortcuts.web-help: Browser combinations: Mod+/, Mod+Shift+,, Mod+Shift+.. Mod is Command on Mac and Ctrl elsewhere.
shortcuts.reserved: This combination is reserved for system or text editing actions.
shortcuts.modifier-required: Include Command, Ctrl, or Alt in the combination.
shortcuts.too-many-keys: Hold at most two non-modifier keys. Release the keys to try again.
shortcuts.macos-web-help: Use Command+/, Command+,, Command+Backslash, Control+Backquote, Command+Option+key, or Command+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
shortcuts.windows-web-help: Use Ctrl+/, Ctrl+,, Ctrl+Alt+key, or Ctrl+Shift+key. Combinations with three or four distinct modifiers are also supported. Browser or system shortcuts may not reach the page.
shortcuts.unsupported-browser: This browser does not support this combination yet.
shortcuts.reset-description: Restore the default shortcuts for this platform. All modified or removed shortcuts will be restored. Other platforms are unaffected.
shortcuts.reset-failed: Could not restore defaults. Your shortcuts are unchanged. Please retry.
shortcuts.review: I have reviewed the latest configuration
shortcuts.stale: Shortcut configuration or available commands changed. Review the latest bindings before saving.
shortcuts.write-failed: Could not save. Your previous shortcuts and current draft are preserved. Please retry.
shortcuts.not-ready: Shortcuts are not ready. Please try again.
shortcuts.read: Could not read {location}. Check access permissions, then {reload}.
shortcuts.invalid: Shortcut configuration in {location} is damaged. Back up and repair this configuration, then {reload}.
shortcuts.future: Shortcut configuration in {location} was created by a newer version. Upgrade Harness and try again.
shortcuts.using-accepted: The last successfully read bindings remain active.
shortcuts.native-failed: Could not protect desktop key recording. Exit recording and try again.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.description: View and edit available shortcuts and input actions
